description: GitHub Actions runs automated jobs for GitHub projects. We will read small workflow files and learn events, jobs, runners and safe permissions without publishing or deploying anything. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
learningObjectives: Practise handle untrusted text as data

seo.title: GitHub Actions Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn GitHub Actions with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
